source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
This model's [transport capacity](vsdata:core-rule/transport-capacity) is 6, for **ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY** models only.

As [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations) begins, you can pick a **SISTERS OF BATTLE SQUAD** of yours and split it into 2 units, with model counts as equal as possible, noting which models form each, and then:

- one of the 2 must begin the battle [embarked](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in this **TRANSPORT**
- the second one can begin the battle inside a different **TRANSPORT**, or be set up as a unit of its own

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
